title: Loop+ Membership Trials, Eligibility Verification and Plan Rollovers
content:
Desk guidance on how a Loop+ Membership starts — with or without a free trial, and with eligibility proof where the plan requires it — and on the two rollovers that move a membership off a plan at its next billing date.

## Governing rule

> A plan that requires eligibility proof starts only after an accepted proof document of its type is provided within the verification days; otherwise the pending membership ends. A buyer gets the plan's free trial unless a trial or paid membership of theirs ended within the trial lookback months before sign-up, in which case the first fee is charged at once. Eligibility is re-verified every re-verification interval counted from the last verified date; when it is not completed within the grace days after it falls due, the membership moves to the failed re-verification rollover plan at its next billing date. A student plan whose tenure reaches the cap moves to its tenure rollover plan at the next billing date.

The verification days, trial length, trial lookback months, re-verification interval, grace days, tenure cap and both rollover plans are the figures of the plan concerned.

## How a new membership leaves pending status

| Situation at sign-up | Result |
|---|---|
| The plan requires eligibility proof and an accepted proof document of its type is provided within the verification days, and the buyer qualifies for the free trial | the membership starts in trial; the trial end date and the date eligibility proof was accepted are recorded |
| The plan requires eligibility proof and an accepted proof document of its type is provided within the verification days, and the buyer does not qualify for the free trial | the membership starts active and the first fee is charged at once |
| The plan requires eligibility proof and no accepted proof document of its type is provided within the verification days | the pending membership ends (cancelled) |
| The plan requires no eligibility proof and the buyer qualifies for the free trial | the membership starts in trial; no eligibility date is recorded |
| The plan requires no eligibility proof and the buyer does not qualify for the free trial | the membership starts active and the first fee is charged at once |

A proof document counts only when it is an accepted document of the type the plan requires.

## The free trial and the lookback

A buyer qualifies for the plan's free trial unless a trial or paid membership of that buyer ended within the trial lookback months before sign-up. Both an ended trial and an ended paid membership withhold the trial.

Hypothetical cases on a plan whose trial lookback is 12 months:

- A buyer's earlier paid Loop+ membership ended 3 months before the new sign-up. It ended within the lookback, so there is no trial and the first fee is charged at once.
- A buyer's earlier Loop+ trial ended 26 months before the new sign-up. It did not end within the lookback, so the buyer gets the plan's free trial.

## Re-verification

Eligibility is re-verified every re-verification interval, counted from the last verified date; each re-verification records the date re-verified, and that date becomes the last verified date. When re-verification is not completed within the grace days after it falls due, the membership moves to the plan's failed re-verification rollover plan, and the move takes place at the membership's next billing date.

Hypothetical case: eligibility on a plan with a 12-month interval was last verified on 1 March 2026, so re-verification falls due on 1 March 2027. If it is still not completed when the grace days after that due date have run, the membership moves to the failed re-verification rollover plan at its next billing date.

## Student tenure cap

A student plan whose tenure reaches the cap moves to its tenure rollover plan at the next billing date. The move is not made on the day the cap is reached but at the next billing date.
